task: Write an email (60–100 words) to Lisa, the IT manager at Kauri Foods, to flag a risk early. The SSL certificate for their customer portal expires on 14 December. Renewing it needs approval from their finance team, which usually takes two weeks. Ask her to start the approval this week.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 的 IT 经理 Lisa 写一封邮件（60–100 词），提前提示一个风险。他们客户门户的 SSL 证书 12 月 14 日到期。续期需要财务团队批准，通常要两周。请她这周就启动审批。
example:
Hi Lisa,
A heads-up: the SSL certificate for your customer portal expires on 14 December.
If it expires, customers will see a security warning and most won't be able to log in. Renewing it needs approval from your finance team, and that usually takes about two weeks, so we don't have much time.
Could you start the approval this week? Once it's approved, we can renew and install it in under an hour.
Kind regards,
{name}

task: Write an email (70–110 words) to your manager Grace to escalate a blocker. You've waited 8 working days for Harbour Council's network team to open port 443 from their data centre to Azure. The migration can't start without it. Ask Grace to raise it at Thursday's steering meeting.
zh: 给经理 Grace 写一封邮件（70–110 词），上报一个阻碍。你已经等了 8 个工作日，Harbour Council 的网络团队还没有开通从他们数据中心到 Azure 的 443 端口。没有它迁移就无法开始。请 Grace 在周四的指导委员会会议上提出这个问题。
example:
Hi Grace,
I need your help with a blocker on the Harbour Council migration.
We've been waiting 8 working days for their network team to open port 443 from the data centre to Azure. Without it, we can't start the migration, and every week we wait pushes the go-live back by a week.
I've chased them three times by email and once by phone, but haven't had a date.
Could you raise it at Thursday's steering meeting? If they can open it by next Wednesday, we can still hit the February date.
Thanks,
{name}

words.en: raise it at the steering meeting
words.zh: 在指导委员会会议上提出

task: Write an email (90–130 words) to Mark, the sponsor at Kauri Foods, asking for a decision. Option A: lift and shift the ordering app to Azure VMs, $8,000, two weeks. Option B: move it to App Service, $20,000, six weeks, but cheaper to run. You need his decision by 27 November to keep the February go-live.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 的发起人 Mark 写一封邮件（90–130 词），请他做决定。方案 A：把订货应用直接迁到 Azure 虚拟机，8,000 元，两周。方案 B：迁到 App Service，20,000 元，六周，但运行成本更低。你需要他在 11 月 27 日前决定，才能保住二月的上线时间。
example:
Hi Mark,
We need your decision on how to move the ordering app by 27 November, so we can keep the February go-live.
There are two options:
- Option A: move it as it is to Azure VMs. It costs $8,000 and takes two weeks. It's the quickest, but running costs stay about the same as today.
- Option B: move it to App Service. It costs $20,000 and takes six weeks, but it's cheaper to run and easier to look after.
Our recommendation is Option B, because the running cost savings pay back the extra cost in about 18 months.
If we don't have a decision by the 27th, we'd have to go with Option A to stay on schedule.
Kind regards,
{name}

task: Write a first outage notice (60–100 words) to Harbour Council stakeholders. Their customer portal has been down since 9:40am. You're still investigating, but it looks like an expired certificate on the Application Gateway. The next update will be at 11am.
zh: 给 Harbour Council 的相关负责人写第一份故障通知（60–100 词）。他们的客户门户从上午 9:40 起无法访问。你们还在排查，但看起来是应用网关上的证书过期了。下次更新在上午 11 点。
example:
Subject: Customer portal outage
Hi all,
The customer portal has been down since 9:40am this morning. Customers can't log in or make payments.
We're investigating now. It looks like the cause is an expired certificate on the Application Gateway, and we're working on replacing it.
We'll send the next update at 11am, or sooner if the portal is back up.
Please direct any customer questions to the service desk in the meantime.
Regards,
{name}

words.en: we're treating this as a priority

words.zh: 对造成的中断表示歉意

task: Write an outage resolved email (80–120 words) to the same Harbour Council stakeholders. The portal was restored at 10:25am, so it was down for 45 minutes. The cause was the expired certificate. To stop it happening again, certificates will now renew automatically from Key Vault.
zh: 给同一批 Harbour Council 相关负责人写一封故障已解决的邮件（80–120 词）。门户在上午 10:25 恢复，一共中断了 45 分钟。原因是证书过期。为防止再次发生，证书今后会通过 Key Vault 自动续期。
example:
Subject: Resolved: customer portal outage
Hi all,
The customer portal is back up. It was restored at 10:25am, so it was down for 45 minutes in total.
What happened: the security certificate on the Application Gateway expired at 9:40am, and the portal stopped accepting connections. We installed a new certificate and tested it before reopening the portal.
What we're doing about it: certificates will now renew automatically from Key Vault, so this can't happen again in the same way. We're also checking every other certificate in your environment this week.
Sorry for the disruption to your customers this morning.
Regards,
{name}

task: Write an email (70–110 words) to Priya, the client's test lead at Kauri Foods. Yesterday you applied a network security rule to the wrong subnet, which blocked her test team for 2 hours. You've reverted it. From now on, every network change will be checked by a second engineer. Admit the mistake clearly.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 的客户测试负责人 Priya 写一封邮件（70–110 词）。你昨天把一条网络安全规则加到了错误的子网上，导致她的测试团队被挡了 2 个小时。你已经撤回了。今后每次网络变更都会由第二名工程师复核。清楚地承认错误。
example:
Hi Priya,
I want to apologise for yesterday's outage in the test environment. It was my mistake.
I applied a network security rule to the wrong subnet, and that blocked your test team for about 2 hours. As soon as we found it, I reverted the change, and everything has been working normally since 3:10pm.
To stop this happening again, every network change will now be checked by a second engineer before it goes in.
If your team needs extra time to catch up on testing, let me know and I'll make sure our side supports it.
Sorry again,
{name}

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to Mark, the sponsor at Kauri Foods. The data migration will finish two weeks late: on 11 December instead of 27 November. The reason is that about 30% of the source records are duplicates and need cleaning. Say what this means for go-live.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 的发起人 Mark 写一封邮件（80–120 词）。数据迁移会晚两周完成：从 11 月 27 日推迟到 12 月 11 日。原因是大约 30% 的源数据记录是重复的，需要清理。说明这对上线有什么影响。
example:
Hi Mark,
The data migration will finish two weeks late, on 11 December instead of 27 November.
The reason is that about 30% of the records in the old system are duplicates. If we move them as they are, staff would see the same customer two or three times in the new system, so we need to clean them first. Your finance team is helping us decide which record to keep.
What this means for go-live: we still have enough time in the plan, so the 1 March date doesn't change. But there's no more buffer, so any further delay would affect it.
I'll update you every Friday until the migration is done.
Kind regards,
{name}

words.zh: 我们还有一些缓冲时间

task: Write an email (70–110 words) to Paul, the Harbour Council IT manager, about a cost impact. Their new backup policy keeps data for 7 years, not 1 year as in the original estimate. That will add about $900 a month to their Azure bill. Ask him to confirm the 7 years is really needed.
zh: 给 Harbour Council 的 IT 经理 Paul 写一封关于成本影响的邮件（70–110 词）。他们新的备份策略要保留数据 7 年，而不是最初估算里的 1 年。这会让 Azure 账单每月增加大约 900 元。请他确认是否真的需要保留 7 年。
example:
Hi Paul,
I want to flag a cost change before it shows up on your bill.
The new backup policy keeps data for 7 years. Our original estimate was based on 1 year, so this will add about $900 a month to your Azure costs.
Could you confirm that 7 years is really needed? If it's for legal reasons, that's fine and we'll update the budget. If not, we could keep monthly backups for 7 years and daily ones for just 30 days, which would cost much less.
Could you let me know by Friday?
Regards,
{name}

task: Write an email (70–110 words) to your project manager Tom about a key person risk. Only Raj knows how the old payroll interface at Kauri Foods works, and he's on leave for three weeks in January, right before go-live. Suggest two knowledge transfer sessions before Christmas.
zh: 给项目经理 Tom 写一封邮件（70–110 词），说明一个关键人员风险。只有 Raj 了解 Kauri Foods 旧薪资接口是怎么运作的，而他一月份要休假三周，正好在上线之前。建议在圣诞节前安排两次知识转移会议。
example:
Hi Tom,
I'd like to flag a risk for the Kauri Foods payroll project.
Raj is the only person who really knows how the old payroll interface works, and he's on leave for three weeks in January, just before go-live. If something breaks while he's away, we could lose days working it out.
To reduce the risk, I suggest two knowledge transfer sessions with Raj before Christmas, about two hours each. I'd attend, and we'd record them and write up the main points.
Can we add this to the risk register and book the sessions this week?
Thanks,
{name}

task: Write an email (90–130 words) to Sarah, your company's security lead. While doing a review for Harbour Council, you found a storage account with public access that contains HR export files. You've already turned off public access. Ask her to check whether anyone accessed the files, and say what you need from her.
zh: 给公司的安全负责人 Sarah 写一封邮件（90–130 词）。在为 Harbour Council 做审查时，你发现一个开放了公共访问的存储账户，里面有人力资源导出文件。你已经关闭了公共访问。请她检查是否有人访问过这些文件，并说明你需要她做什么。
example:
Hi Sarah,
I've found a possible data exposure at Harbour Council and need your help.
This morning, during the security review, I found a storage account with public access turned on. It contains HR export files, including staff names and salaries.
I turned off public access at 10:15am, so the files can no longer be reached from the internet. I haven't deleted or changed anything else.
What I need from you:
- Check the storage logs to see if anyone outside the council accessed the files.
- Let me know if we need to tell the client's privacy officer now, or after the check.
The account name and screenshots are in the attached document. I'm free all afternoon if you'd like to talk it through.
Thanks,
{name}

task: Write an email (70–110 words) to Mark at Kauri Foods about a dependency risk. The payroll software vendor still hasn't confirmed that their product supports SQL Server 2022, which is in the design. If they don't confirm by 4 December, the go-live date is at risk. Say what the fallback is.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 的 Mark 写一封邮件（70–110 词），说明一个依赖风险。薪资软件供应商还没有确认他们的产品支持设计中采用的 SQL Server 2022。如果 12 月 4 日前不确认，上线日期就有风险。说明备选方案是什么。
example:
Hi Mark,
I want to flag a risk to the go-live date.
The payroll software vendor still hasn't confirmed that their product supports SQL Server 2022, which is what we're using in the design. We asked them three weeks ago and have chased twice.
If we don't hear back by 4 December, we'll need to switch to our fallback: SQL Server 2019. It's fully supported, but it would mean rebuilding the test database, which adds about a week.
It would really help if you could raise this with your account manager at the vendor.
Kind regards,
{name}

task: Write a message (50–90 words) to your manager Grace about your workload. In December you're booked at 60% on Harbour Council and 60% on Kauri Foods, which is more than full time. Ask which project should come first.
zh: 给经理 Grace 写一条关于工作量的消息（50–90 词）。十二月你在 Harbour Council 上被安排了 60%，在 Kauri Foods 上也是 60%，加起来超过了全职。问她哪个项目优先。
example:
Hi Grace,
I've noticed that in December I'm booked at 60% on Harbour Council and 60% on Kauri Foods. That's 120%, so something will slip if we don't change it.
Which project should come first? If it's Harbour Council, I could ask Raj to take some of the Kauri Foods testing.
Could we sort it out this week, so both clients know what to expect?
Thanks,
{name}

words.en: I want to flag it now

words.zh: 而不是让任何一方延误

task: Write an incident report email (100–150 words) to Helen, the Harbour Council CIO. During last night's mailbox migration, a wrongly set up connector delayed email delivery for 3 hours. About 1,200 emails were delayed, but none were lost. Explain what happened, the impact, and what you're changing.
zh: 给 Harbour Council 的首席信息官 Helen 写一封事故报告邮件（100–150 词）。在昨晚的邮箱迁移中，一个配置错误的连接器导致邮件投递延迟了 3 个小时。大约 1,200 封邮件被延迟，但没有丢失。说明发生了什么、影响如何，以及你们要做哪些改变。
example:
Subject: Incident report: delayed email on 19 November
Hi Helen,
Last night, email delivery for council staff was delayed by about 3 hours. Around 1,200 emails were held up, but none were lost, and all have now been delivered.
What happened: during the mailbox migration, we set up a new mail connector with the wrong server address. Incoming email went into a queue instead of being delivered. Our monitoring picked it up at 1am, and we fixed the connector by 1:40am.
Impact: emails sent to staff between 10:30pm and 1:40am arrived late. No emails were bounced back to senders.
What we're changing: from now on, every connector change will be tested with a test mailbox before we switch live mail over, and a second engineer will check the settings.
I'm sorry for the disruption. Happy to go through it in more detail if that helps.
Regards,
{name}

task: Post a message (50–80 words) in the dev team's Teams channel. The build pipeline has failed 4 times since this morning because the build agents are out of disk space. You're freeing up space now. Ask people not to merge until it's fixed.
zh: 在开发团队的 Teams 频道发一条消息（50–80 词）。从今天早上开始，构建流水线已经失败了 4 次，原因是构建代理的磁盘空间满了。你正在清理空间。请大家在修好之前不要合并代码。
example:
Heads-up, team: the build pipeline has failed 4 times since this morning because the build agents are out of disk space.
I'm clearing out old build files now and expect it to be fixed within the hour.
Please don't merge anything to main until I post here again, otherwise your build will just fail too. Sorry for the hassle.

task: Write an email (90–130 words) to your manager Grace about budget. The Harbour Council project has used 70% of its budget but is only about 50% complete. The main reasons are extra testing the client asked for and two weeks lost to the firewall delay. Ask for a meeting to agree what to do.
zh: 给经理 Grace 写一封关于预算的邮件（90–130 词）。Harbour Council 项目已经用了 70% 的预算，但只完成了大约 50%。主要原因是客户要求的额外测试，以及防火墙延误损失的两周。请求开个会商量怎么办。
example:
Hi Grace,
I'm concerned about the Harbour Council budget. We've used 70% of it, but the project is only about 50% complete.
The two main reasons are:
- Extra testing the client asked for in October, which wasn't in the original scope. It added about 60 hours.
- Two weeks lost to the firewall delay, when the team was booked but couldn't make progress.
If nothing changes, we'll run out of budget in early February, about four weeks before the end.
I think we have a good case for a change request for the extra testing. Could we meet this week to agree what to do before I raise it with the client?
Thanks,
{name}

task: Write an email (100–140 words) to Mark, the Kauri Foods sponsor, asking for a go/no-go decision on Saturday's cutover. Testing found 2 open defects: one medium (a report shows the wrong date format) and one low (a spelling mistake on a screen). You recommend going ahead with a workaround. You need his decision by Thursday at 5pm.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 的发起人 Mark 写一封邮件（100–140 词），请他对周六的割接做“上线 / 不上线”的决定。测试还剩 2 个未解决的缺陷：一个中等（某个报表日期格式不对），一个低（某个界面有拼写错误）。你建议用临时解决办法继续上线。你需要他在周四下午 5 点前做决定。
example:
Hi Mark,
We need your go/no-go decision for Saturday's cutover by Thursday at 5pm.
Our recommendation is go. Testing is complete, and there are only 2 open defects:
- Medium: the monthly leave report shows dates in US format (month first). The workaround is to export it to Excel, which fixes the format. The vendor will fix it in the next release, due in January.
- Low: a spelling mistake on the timesheet screen. It doesn't affect how anything works.
Neither defect affects pay, and your payroll team has agreed the workaround is fine for now.
If you decide no-go, the next possible cutover date is 9 January, after the holiday freeze.
Please reply to this email with your decision.
Kind regards,
{name}

task: Write an email (70–110 words) to Paul at Harbour Council. Their IT change freeze runs from 15 December to 11 January, so the build window before Christmas is shorter than planned. Suggest bringing the network and backup tasks forward to the week of 30 November.
zh: 给 Harbour Council 的 Paul 写一封邮件（70–110 词）。他们的 IT 变更冻结期是 12 月 15 日到 1 月 11 日，所以圣诞前的搭建时间比计划的短。建议把网络和备份的任务提前到 11 月 30 日那一周。
example:
Hi Paul,
I've just realised your change freeze, from 15 December to 11 January, cuts our build window before Christmas by a week.
If we keep the current plan, the network and backup tasks would land in the freeze, and we'd have to wait until mid-January. That would push the whole project back by about four weeks.
My suggestion is to bring both tasks forward to the week of 30 November. Our team is available, but we'd need your network engineer for two days that week.
Would that work on your side?
Regards,
{name}

words.en: would that work for your team

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to Janet, the practice manager at Coastal Dental. Four of their servers still run Windows Server 2012 R2, which no longer gets security updates. Explain the risk in plain words and give two options: buy extended security updates for a year, or upgrade the servers for about $6,000.
zh: 给 Coastal Dental 的诊所经理 Janet 写一封邮件（80–120 词）。他们有四台服务器还在运行 Windows Server 2012 R2，已经收不到安全更新了。用通俗的话解释风险，并给出两个选择：购买一年的扩展安全更新，或者花大约 6,000 元升级服务器。
example:
Hi Janet,
Four of your servers still run Windows Server 2012 R2, and Microsoft no longer sends security updates for it.
In plain terms, any new security hole found in these servers won't be fixed. That makes them an easy target for attackers, and some insurers won't cover you if a breach starts on an unsupported system.
You have two options:
- Buy extended security updates for one year. This is the quickest fix, but it only buys time.
- Upgrade the servers, for about $6,000. This solves the problem properly.
We'd recommend the upgrade. Happy to talk it through on a call this week.
Kind regards,
{name}

task: Write an email (50–90 words) to Lisa at Kauri Foods. You promised to send the cost estimate for the extra AVD users on Monday, but you forgot. Say sorry without making excuses, attach it today, and point out the total: $1,350 a month.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 的 Lisa 写一封邮件（50–90 词）。你答应周一发给她新增 AVD 用户的成本估算，但忘了。道歉但不找借口，今天附上估算，并指出总额：每月 1,350 元。
example:
Hi Lisa,
Sorry, I promised you the cost estimate for the extra AVD users on Monday and didn't send it. That's on me.
It's attached now. The total comes to $1,350 a month for the 25 extra users, including licences and Azure costs.
If you have any questions, I'm happy to go through it on a quick call.
Kind regards,
{name}

words.en: happy to walk you through it

task: Write an email (90–130 words) to Michelle, your company's Microsoft account manager, asking her to escalate a support case. The case for Harbour Council has been open for 6 days at Severity B with no real progress. Their file sync to Azure has stopped, and staff at two sites can't see new files.
zh: 给你们公司在微软的客户经理 Michelle 写一封邮件（90–130 词），请她把一个支持案例升级处理。Harbour Council 的这个案例以 B 级严重程度开了 6 天，没有实质进展。他们同步到 Azure 的文件已经停止同步，两个站点的员工看不到新文件。
example:
Hi Michelle,
Could you please help us escalate a support case? It's been open for 6 days with no real progress.
The case is for Harbour Council, raised as Severity B on 14 November. Their file sync to Azure has stopped, and staff at two sites can't see any new files. They're now emailing documents to each other to keep working, which is a real problem for a council.
We've sent all the logs Microsoft asked for, but the case has changed engineers twice and we keep starting again.
We'd like an engineer who can stay with the case, and ideally a call in the next 24 hours.
The case number is in the subject line. Thanks for your help.
Regards,
{name}
